commit.message:
Check AppImage while install and alternate --appimage-extract with 7z (#2443)

* Option nolibfuse, fall back to 7z if --appimage-extract does not work

ref https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM/issues/2442

* Option -i, replace --appimage-extract with a function (DRAFT)

ref https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM/issues/2442

* Option -i, check safely if executable file is an AppImage...

...and then alternate --appimage-extract with 7z if the first fails

This will prevent execution of fake AppImages.

* Silence appimage-extract errors

ref https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM/issues/2442#issuecomment-4819923969

* Escape dot for regex

ref https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM/pull/2443#discussion_r3487500370

* More readable function to extract AppImages + 7zz support

* Add _appimage_extract function using sed (fix for freeBSD)

* Re-add --appimage-extract (typo)

* Add TAB spaces and exit 1 if extraction fails

* Check if file supports --appimage-extract, use 2 functions, add exit 0

* Back to one function

* Update install.am

* Update APP-MANAGER
